summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive releases and public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor and operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results. Authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive release, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: continue existing read-only evidence capture, maintain private launch gates, and permit only reversible growth preserving existing consent, disclosures, data, and claims boundaries.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
